Theo (Customer): Hey team, running embeddings POST /v1/embeddings and getting wrong dimension for a long-running job. customer sees 1536 dims but app expects 1024. blocking production. ticket: https://zendesk.example/tkt/54821
Maya (Support): hi @Theo — sorry about that. can you paste the request headers (sanitized) and the exact response body?
Theo (Customer): here's sanitized request:```
POST /v1/embeddings
Authorization: Bearer sk-org_ABC123
X-Project-Id: project-44
Content-Type: application/json
{"model":"text-embed-large-1024","input":["hello world"]}
```response:```
200 OK
{"data":[{"embedding":[0.01, ...],"index":0}],"model":"text-embed-large-1536","usage":{}}
```so model returned is 1536 vector despite request asking for 1024 model.
Maya (Support): hmm interesting — customer header shows org key in Authorization and also X-Project-Id. Our routing should prefer project header when present. sending to eng-ml. cc @Anika @Jasper
ops-bot: New support escalation created: ESC-54821 assigned to eng-ml.
Anika (Eng-ML): quick check: is the request hitting the embeddings routing service or the fallback proxy? can you share the original raw request timestamp and any proxy logs?
Theo (Customer): I have a copy from their side:```
[2025-06-12T14:05:23Z] -> /v1/embeddings Authorization=sk-org_ABC123 X-Project-Id=project-44 body={"model":"text-embed-large-1024","input":["q"]}
[2025-06-12T14:05:23Z] <- 200 model=text-embed-large-1536
```
Anika (Eng-ML): thanks. looking at our routing rules: if `Authorization` contains an org-scoped key and `X-Project-Id` is present, precedence should be: project header > org header > org fallback. That said, there was a recent change in auth-proxy where legacy org tokens with prefix `sk-org_` accidentally got higher priority.
Jasper (SRE): I see spikes in the proxy logs around that time where `auth-proxy` returned project=null and the request was routed to org-default-models cluster. snippet from auth-proxy log:```
{"ts":"2025-06-12T14:05:23Z","req_id":"r-9f3","auth_type":"org","project_header":"project-44","resolved_project":null,"reason":"legacy-org-override"}
```
Maya (Support): so resolved_project=null even though header existed. customer confirmed X-Project-Id was set. could be a header normalization or case-sensitivity bug.
Anika (Eng-ML): reproduction steps I tried locally:
1) send request with Authorization=sk-org_test and X-Project-Id=projX specifying model text-embed-large-1024
2) if auth-proxy resolves project correctly, final routing sends to embed-1024 pool.
3) with the buggy code path (older auth-proxy image) it drops project and routes to embed-1536.
commands:```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/embeddings \
 -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-org_test" \
 -H "X-Project-Id: projX" \
 -d '{"model":"text-embed-large-1024","input":["a"]}'
```expected: model=text-embed-large-1024, got: text-embed-large-1536 for bad build.
Jasper (SRE): rolling back auth-proxy to stable (sha: a1b2c3) should mitigate. I can push a hotfix to respect project header precedence.
Theo (Customer): timeline for rollback? this hits our nightly batch. we need it fixed before 02:00 UTC.
Maya (Support): Jasper, can you confirm ETA?
Jasper (SRE): rolling back within 18 minutes. patch will also add a test for header case-insensitivity.
Anika (Eng-ML): additional note: some customers set `x-project-id` (lowercase). auth-proxy normalize to lowercase, but our internal check looked for `X-Project-Id` (camelcase) due to a recent refactor. added unit test.
Maya (Support): will update Theo once rollback confirmed and provide repro steps to verify on their side.
ops-bot: Deployment started auth-proxy rollback -> stable:a1b2c3 by Jasper.
Jasper (SRE): rollback done at 2025-06-12T14:21:05Z. verified resolved_project=project-44 in logs. snippet:```
{"ts":"2025-06-12T14:21:05Z","req_id":"r-9f3","auth_type":"org","project_header":"project-44","resolved_project":"project-44","route":"embed-1024-pool"}
```
Maya (Support): Theo, can you re-run your failing job now and paste results?
Theo (Customer): re-ran nightly job. now embeddings show 1024 dims. thank you! :tada:
Maya (Support): great. we're leaving ESC-54821 open for 48h to monitor. root cause: auth-proxy regression that prioritized legacy org keys and failed to normalize header casing, dropping X-Project-Id. fix: rollback + unit test + added integration test for project header precedence.
Anika (Eng-ML): follow-up: we'll add an alert for resolved_project==null with project header present. also creating a small migration task to canonicalize header checks across services.
Theo (Customer): appreciate the fast response. can you send a short postmortem once ready so we can share internally?
Maya (Support): will do — linking the postmortem here when available. ESC-54821 will include timeline and patch links.
ops-bot: ESC-54821 status: monitoring (48h).
